pythonSource.scope: Canonical causal architecture, dropout 0 and bias true. Browser implementation qualified by Python forward, gradient and AdamW fixtures; task encoding is a separate adapter.

taskAdapter.selection: argmax restricted to three action tokens; no world-based action masking
taskAdapter.objective: last-token cross-entropy over all 128 vocabulary classes
taskAdapter.sampler: all reachable examples shuffled once per round

scope: Python transformer core with explicitly labelled capability extensions. Full-map supervised imitation, including historical observation/action records when memory is enabled. No hidden-object, key or door task; no unseen-map guarantee.

canonicalMicroWorld.scope: One agent; floor, walls, active lamp; forward/turn-left/turn-right/wait; 9x9 egocentric observation; canonical day cycle, lamp light and wall occlusion. No other mechanics ported.
